summary: This standards-track document defines a framework in which application logic and media processing run on different machines. A controlling application uses SIP to set up a control channel to a media server and then sends commands over it. Packages then define specific functions.

eli5.summary: A director in one room tells a stage crew in another room what to play. This defines the phone line between them and how commands are sent.

questions: what is the media control channel framework
how to control media server remotely
